windows.name: Know The Mice for Windows
windows.description: Modern Liquid Glass installer with pure black aesthetic, auto-start, system tray host, firewall rules, and desktop shortcuts.
windows.changelog:
- Resolved Update Failed banner issue: silent background checks, fallback download URL, and dismissible notification
- Updated Windows application PNG logo with optical centering and transparent background
- Windows UI/UX redesign: Liquid Glass translucent cards, AMOLED black styling, unified 24x24 vector stroke icon system
- Seamless in-place upgrades: preserve paired devices and settings without uninstalling
- Borderless WindowChrome custom title bar with multi-monitor snap and maximize bounds
- Active host process graceful shutdown during upgrade to prevent file locks
- Single-file setup installer and enterprise WiX MSI package

android.name: Know The Mice for Android
requirements: Connected to the same local Wi-Fi as your PC
android.description: Unified Remote Control screen with instant 1-tap Mouse ↔ Keyboard switching, background Foreground Service connection persistence, screen-off auto-recovery, and exponential backoff engine.
android.changelog:
- Unified Mouse ↔ Keyboard control screen with instant 1-tap Apple-style Liquid Glass switcher
- Foreground Service connection persistence across phone sleep/screen-off/background
- Exponential backoff auto-reconnect engine with network change detection
- Sticky modifier safety release preventing stuck keys on PC
